name: DNS Threat & Anomaly Monitoring
description: Real-time visibility into internal DNS requests, anomalous query volumes, top queried domains, and suspicious record types.

queries.current_sql: SELECT count(*) AS metric_value FROM %catalog.dns_logs WHERE log_ts BETWEEN :start_ts AND :end_ts
queries.previous_sql: SELECT count(*) AS metric_value FROM %catalog.dns_logs WHERE log_ts BETWEEN :prev_start_ts AND :prev_end_ts
queries.sparkline_sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', log_ts) AS bucket_ts, count(*) AS metric_value FROM %catalog.dns_logs WHERE log_ts BETWEEN :start_ts AND :end_ts GROUP BY date_trunc('day', log_ts)

queries.sql: SELECT record_type AS label, count(*) AS value FROM %catalog.dns_logs WHERE log_ts BETWEEN :start_ts AND :end_ts GROUP BY record_type

widgets.title: Daily DNS Volume by Transport Protocol

queries.sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', log_ts) AS bucket_ts, transport AS category, count(*) AS metric_value FROM %catalog.dns_logs WHERE log_ts BETWEEN :start_ts AND :end_ts GROUP BY date_trunc('day', log_ts), transport
SELECT host, url_domain, src_ip, dest_ip, record_type, query_count, transport FROM %catalog.dns_logs WHERE log_ts BETWEEN :start_ts AND :end_ts
